name: Galantamine
metabolism: CYP2D6 forms O-desmethylgalantamine and CYP3A4 forms galantamine N-oxide. Glucuronidation and urinary excretion of unchanged drug also contribute.
summary: Galantamine is an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor used to treat early-stage Alzheimer's disease and memory impairment. It is an alkaloid found in several plants in the Amaryllidaceae family and can also be produced synthetically.
